v1.0.13: Mobile banking website-to-official-app interoperability fixes.
- GeckoView NavigationDelegate intercepts user-clicked, HTTPS-origin intent:// and custom native app links.
- Strict, reconstructed Android ACTION_VIEW + BROWSABLE Intents; no untrusted extras/component/flags; native app handoff only after explicit confirmation.
- Explicit browser menu: Open in mobile app, uses Android verified non-browser app route on Android 11+ where supported.
- GeckoView JS alert/confirm/prompt dialogs display the current HTTPS origin and never log credentials.
- No bank device security bypass or cloned native banking app. Bank-owned app identity cannot be verified by the browser; user must validate official installed bank app.
- No promise of all-bank login compatibility, native bank biometric, FIDO2/passkey, or new-window federated auth support.
- Prior v1.0.12 WireGuard & visual header intact.
- Check python tools/check_banking_compat.py, JVM tests, 3 ABI signed APKs, original production cert and successful upgrade from v1.0.12.
- Physical banking-app acceptance tests require bank name/error, and MUST NOT request passwords, SMS codes or account details.
Docs: docs/ANDROID_BANK_COMPAT_V113.md
Source/compile passing example: https://github.com/mmustafatasoy/EymenBrowser/actions/runs/42211537520
